notes.title: Forest Rework
notes.content:
Hello everybody !
After some months without update, we decided to make an article about the progress of the development of the game.
Firstly, the team has a new member :) A new programmer decided to help us for the rest of the adventure.

The previous months, the team has made a lot of progress on the horror game mode, but we have also decided to do a rework of the first game mode. We have thought that a lot of things were not good and that we could do a much more fun game mode ! It is why we focus now into this rework. This is a list of the main changes :

A smaller map, to avoid the exploration and to promote the action
No more craft and items to gather around the map, it is not a marathon simulator for f*** sake !
Replacement of the melee weapons with distance weapons (like bow and guns)
No more objectives to defend, defend your skin and nothing else !
More monsters with different types that the player will need to learn (explosive monster, armored, leader…)
A gameplay for the day focused into the preparation of the terrain (workbench used to place traps and equipments for the monsters)
News machines incoming to help the player, like the slot machine, or a machine to command weapons and objects !


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37954114/e29bebf86350afea1b397694ebe99479d9c29c6e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37954114/e9eee2f058621e571a0097092335eea8b286432e.png

More ideas are planned, but there it is for the main changes ! We implement little to little of these new systems and we hope to release a new version of the game very soon :)

Thank you,
The DeadSigns team

notes.title: Forest Update and new game mode in development !
notes.content:
Hello everyone ːsteamhappyː

We have two announcements to make for today, the first one concerns a new update that fixes a lot of problems in addition to adding some features to the game ! Here is a general list :


 The game has now a loading screen
 The UI has been improved
 Fixes about the game preferences (now saving correctly)
 The items have now an outline effect
 Fixes about the turrets
 Improvements on the plastic lamp (in the cave)
 Fixes about the enemies attacks
 Some items take less space in inventory


That’s all for this first news, the second concerns the arrival of a Game-Designer in our team and the development of a new game mode !

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37954114/3cc9fe66e01930052977bc90fccf63355a011cee.png

Indeed, a new person has joined our ranks, which makes us a team of 3. Thanks to this, everyone will be able to specialize more in their own field of expertise and we will gain efficiency. As for the new game mode, it will be oriented towards horror and a well-crafted scenario. We have a desire to scare the player, which the first game mode has trouble doing, because it is rather action-oriented.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37954114/acfe6df8f3807c34af2a9c013470ec32743f8c0b.png

As far as our progress is concerned, we are at the very beginning. A scenario is already in place in broad strokes, and as you can see a small piece of environment points the tip of it's nose.

We will inform you as soon as we have more concrete, in the meantime do not hesitate to give us feedback on the current content, we will be happy to take them into account to improve the game.

Wishing you all a happy holiday,
The DeadSigns Team

notes.title: Third update ! Potions and resins
notes.content:
Hello there !

For this third update of DeadSigns, we added a lot of features :

 Complete redesign of the game interface
 A compass which indicate to the player the areas where the objects spawn
 Combats are more nervous, you can now quickly attack non stop ! But be careful to the fatigue...
 In each game you will have to find a hidden object
 6 potions available to boost the player (force, stamina, resistance, attack speed, movement speed, resurrection...)
 2 resins which allow you to boost your weapon with fire or poison
 Recipes are saved between games !
 Corsican plants grow on the map and are useful to create potions and resins
 The monsters can drop loots for potions and resins
 Empty bottles can be find and filled up at the river to create potions
 Work on the sound design in the cave/cabin/forest
 A lot of tutorials have been added to help new players
 And a lot more of small fixes to improve the game !


We also take the decision to develop a new game mode horror oriented with an interior environment. We will take one week per month to improve the forest game mode.

Don’t forget ! The game is actively in development. If you have reviews to improve some aspects of the game we will be happy to take them into account. You can contact us at this address : deadsignsteam@gmail.com

Wishing you a pleasant day,
The DeadSigns Team

notes.title: Second update ! Defensive stance and electric trap
notes.content:
Hey !

Here we are in the second update of the game. This is the main new features :

The player can now go into a defensive stance with certain weapons, to cancel damage but his weapon durability will decrease
A new trap is available on the day five. It sends electric impulsion around him and slow down enemies. But be careful, it will eventually explode due to overheating
The control panel has been removed, the generator now controls everything
Confirmation buttons for some actions have been added (restart the game, exit, sleep)
The HUD display a day counter in game
Weapons strikes are more bloody
Two big bug are now fixed : the inventory was deleting objects when you move them and the bow arrow at framerate below 60 could miss obstacles


Don’t forget ! The game is actively in development. If you have reviews to improve some aspects of the game we will be happy to take them into account. You can contact us at this address : deadsignsteam@gmail.com

We made a devlog if you want to see more (english subtitles available)

notes.title: First update ! 14/07/2020
notes.content:
Hello there !

We would like to thank the people who bought and tested the game. Following the feedback of some players, we already offer you a first update. Without further ado, here is a summary of the main new features :


 The game has been speed up, then you can discover more contents in less time. The weapons recipes are available much earlier.
 We offer from the beginning a bow, some arrows and a health kit
 A radar now shows the location of objects and enemies close to the player
 Monsters animations have been improved in general
 Each monster has 3 new attacks, and the difficulty curve has been improved


Don’t forget ! The game is actively in development. If you have reviews to improve some aspects of the game we will be happy to take them into account. You can contact us at this address : deadsignsteam@gmail.com
